verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is a platform for building AI agents, so letting those agents connect to external MCP servers as a client is a fair axis. The evidence only documents Trigger.dev's own MCP server, which lets AI assistants like Claude Code and Cursor interact with Trigger.dev projects. That is the server role, a different story, and it does not show Trigger.dev tasks or agents consuming tools from third-party MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
